summary.intent: Add four new E2E test suite todos to the planning state for cipher-box.
summary.outcome: Four todos were added and committed, but the pending count in STATE.md was incorrectly reported as 14 (6+4) when the actual count was 10 (6+4). The error was caught by the user and corrected.

repo: STATE.md in .planning/ tracks pending todo counts and can become stale, requiring verification against actual state rather than trusting the stored value.

code.finding: Stores pending todo count that can go stale; always verify actual count before doing arithmetic on it.

workflow: Always verify current state from source of truth before performing arithmetic on counters — stale cached values lead to compounding errors.
When reporting state changes (e.g. 'X → Y'), recount from actual data rather than relying on previously stored counts.

friction: STATE.md contained a stale pending count (showed 6 when actual was already 10), causing an incorrect 6+4=14 report instead of 10.
The assistant propagated the stale value without verification, requiring the user to catch the discrepancy.
